verdict.rationale: Quo is a commercial business-phone SaaS, and asking whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a public source repository or an open license. The published OpenAPI documents and the public MCP server are API description and access surfaces, not product source code, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
